The script should accept various command line arguments to customize the output, such as input UFO, output file, glyph info CSV file, font code, log file name, list of BCP47 language tags, right-to-left feature enabling, rendering check disabling, test name, font source, text scaling, anchor points regular expression, total width of all string column, and XSL stylesheet. The script should read the input CSV, initialize the FTML document, and add encoded characters, unencoded specials and ligatures, Lam-Alef data, and diacritic attachment data to the document based on the provided arguments. Finally, the script should write the output FTML file.

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import argparse
import csv
import sys
import re
from pathlib import Path
from pysilfont.ftml import FTML
from pysilfont.ufo import openFont

def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate FTML from UFO and glyph data CSV using pysilfont.")
    parser.add_argument("--ufo", required=True, help="Input UFO font directory")
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="Output FTML file")
    parser.add_argument("--csv", required=True, help="Glyph info CSV file")
    parser.add_argument("--fontcode", default="", help="Font code")
    parser.add_argument("--log", default=None, help="Log file name")
    parser.add_argument("--langs", default="", help="Comma-separated list of BCP47 language tags")
    parser.add_argument("--rtl", action="store_true", help="Enable right-to-left feature")
    parser.add_argument("--norendercheck", action="store_true", help="Disable rendering check")
    parser.add_argument("--testname", default="Test", help="Test name")
    parser.add_argument("--fontsrc", default="", help="Font source")
    parser.add_argument("--scale", type=float, default=1.0, help="Text scaling factor")
    parser.add_argument("--anchorre", default="", help="Anchor points regular expression")
    parser.add_argument("--totalwidth", type=int, default=0, help="Total width of all string column")
    parser.add_argument("--xsl", default=None, help="XSL stylesheet")
    return parser.parse_args()

def read_csv(csv_path):
    with open(csv_path, newline='', encoding='utf-8') as csvfile:
        reader = csv.DictReader(csvfile)
        rows = [row for row in reader]
    return rows

def main():
    args = parse_args()

    # Logging
    if args.log:
        sys.stderr = open(args.log, "w")

    # Open UFO font
    font = openFont(args.ufo, layers=True)

    # Read glyph data CSV
    glyph_rows = read_csv(args.csv)

    # Prepare FTML document
    ftml = FTML(testname=args.testname, fontsrc=args.fontsrc, xsl=args.xsl)
    ftml.setFont(font, fontcode=args.fontcode, scale=args.scale)

    # Set languages
    langs = [l.strip() for l in args.langs.split(",") if l.strip()]
    if langs:
        ftml.setLangs(langs)

    # Set RTL
    if args.rtl:
        ftml.setRTL(True)

    # Set rendering check
    if args.norendercheck:
        ftml.setRenderCheck(False)

    # Set anchor regex
    anchorre = re.compile(args.anchorre) if args.anchorre else None

    # Add encoded characters, specials, ligatures, Lam-Alef, diacritics
    for row in glyph_rows:
        glyphname = row.get("glyphname") or row.get("GlyphName")
        unicodeval = row.get("unicode") or row.get("Unicode")
        typ = row.get("type") or row.get("Type", "").lower()
        string = row.get("string") or row.get("String")
        comment = row.get("comment") or row.get("Comment", "")

        # Encoded characters
        if typ == "encoded" and unicodeval:
            ftml.addChar(glyphname, int(unicodeval, 16), comment=comment)

        # Specials (unencoded)
        elif typ == "special":
            ftml.addSpecial(glyphname, comment=comment)

        # Ligatures
        elif typ == "ligature":
            ftml.addLigature(glyphname, string, comment=comment)

        # Lam-Alef
        elif typ == "lamalef":
            ftml.addLamAlef(glyphname, string, comment=comment)

        # Diacritic attachment
        elif typ == "diacritic":
            if anchorre:
                anchors = [a for a in font[glyphname].anchors if anchorre.match(a.name)]
            else:
                anchors = font[glyphname].anchors
            ftml.addDiacritic(glyphname, anchors, comment=comment)

    # Set total width if specified
    if args.totalwidth > 0:
        ftml.setTotalWidth(args.totalwidth)

    # Write FTML output
    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as outf:
        outf.write(ftml.toXML())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
